subject: Consolidated processor roster + confirmation of international transfer safeguards
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@fintegrate.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@fintegrate.com>, compliance@fintegrate.com
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated processor roster + transfer safeguards

Hi Vanessa,

Fintegrate is updating our vendor inventory ahead of an upcoming audit. Can you send a consolidated processor roster for Redwood (current as of today) that includes:
- vendor name and role (processor/subprocessor)
- country of processing/hosting
- whether transfers rely on SCCs, adequacy decisions, or VPC-only controls
- KMS/HSM provider if used for customer key material

Separately, we need a short confirmation of how Redwood handles international transfers for customer data (SCCs vs EU-region-only hosting vs contractual safeguards) and whether any recent subprocessor additions in the last 12 months routed EU-origin data outside the EU.

If you have a short export or spreadsheet, please attach. LegalOps may need an amendment or signing link for any subprocessor additions. Our audit window starts 2028-04-02, so an initial response by 2028-03-17 would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Compliance
Fintegrate

[attachment: audit_request_finstrategy.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@fintegrate.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, LegalOps <legalops@fintegrate.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated processor roster + transfer safeguards

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching our consolidated vendor roster export (vendor_roster_20280313.xlsx) and a short summary of our transfer safeguards (scc-and-dta-summary.pdf).

Quick notes up front:
- Most hosted workloads for Fintegrate are handled by our US and EU clusters; EU-origin traffic can be pinned to EU region when requested.
- Transfers: default contractual mechanism is EU SCCs; for customers requiring stronger controls we offer Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and a KMS integration.
- In the last 12 months we added two small infra vendors; one (EdgeStream Inc) processes logs in an EU region but transcodes to a US bucket for longer-term retention — flagged below.

Kimberly / Rafael / Priya — can you confirm the KMS provider used for Fintegrate (customer-managed or Redwood-managed), whether EdgeStream's US retention is covered by SCCs/DTA, and if SOC2 evidence for the new vendors is captured? I copied LegalOps in case Fintegrate wants an amendment/DocuSign.

Next steps we propose:
1) We’ll send the roster + summary now.
2) If Fintegrate wants a signed amendment for EdgeStream specifically, we can route to LegalOps and prepare a targeted DPA addendum.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[attachments: vendor_roster_20280313.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), scc-and-dta-summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated processor roster + transfer safeguards

Vanessa — quick answers below; I pulled the vendor evidence folder and attached the SOC2 snapshot.

- KMS: For Fintegrate's account we have customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (customer supplied CMKs) in the EU region as requested during onboarding. Redwood-managed encryption keys are used for default eligibly-scoped workloads only.
- EdgeStream Inc (new): they perform short-term processing in eu-west-1 but their archival pipeline lands in a US storage bucket operated by EdgeStream. We require an SCC-based contractual flow for that vendor and have an active Data Transfer Addendum (DTA) on file, but LegalOps flagged that we should re-notify affected customers per our DPA clause because EdgeStream's retention path was updated after onboarding.
- SOC2 evidence: attached a 2027 SOC2 snapshot for EdgeStream and an internal runbook (soc2-evidence-redwood-observability.zip).

Recommendation: notify Fintegrate with an explicit subprocessor update notice and offer the option to restrict routing to EU-only (via a Private deployment or by enabling EU-only archival policies) while LegalOps prepares an amendment.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

[attachment: soc2-evidence-redwood-observability.zip (application/zip)]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated processor roster + transfer safeguards

Following up on the routing options:
- Short-term mitigation: we can enable EU-only archival routing for Fintegrate’s tenant (no infra change, just a policy toggle) which prevents EdgeStream from exporting to US buckets for that tenant. That will be enforced at the storage export stage and logged.
- Long-term: we should offer Fintegrate a tokenization/partial-pseudonymization plan for certain log fields before export. That would require a small engineer timebox (2–3 weeks) but lowers exposure and may remove the need for an amendment for that specific flow.

If Fintegrate accepts EU-only routing, we can enact the change immediately and provide logs showing the export path (as evidence).

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@fintegrate.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com, LegalOps <legalops@fintegrate.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated processor roster + transfer safeguards

Alicia — attaching the consolidated roster and our SCC/DTA summary. Key points and proposed next steps:
1) Summary: most processing occurs in EU/US clusters; default contractual safeguard for cross-border is EU SCCs; customers can request EU-only hosting or Private deployment.
2) Subprocessor change: EdgeStream (processing/archival path updated after onboarding) is covered by an SCC+DTA, but per our DPA we need to notify customers. We’ve attached SOC2 evidence and propose an amendment if Fintegrate prefers a contractual confirmation.
3) Short-term mitigation: we can enable EU-only archival routing for Fintegrate immediately; Rafael will provide export-path logs once enabled.
4) Optional remediation: discuss tokenization/pseudonymization engineering scope (2–3 week estimate) if you want to eliminate cross-border archival for log data entirely.

Next steps recommended:
- Please confirm whether you want the immediate EU-only routing toggle (we can deploy within 24 hours).
- If you want an amendment, LegalOps will put a DocuSign link together for signature — I copied them.

If you’d like a brief call to walk through the roster and evidence, we can do 30 minutes this week.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[attachments: vendor_roster_20280313.xlsx, scc-and-dta-summary.pdf]
